title: Discrete gradient
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $x$ be an input. The discrete gradient of $f$ at $x$ is the vector in $ br^n$ whose coordinate in direction $i$ is the discrete derivative of $f$ in that direction at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the $n$-dimensional sign cube.
$x$ is an input in the $n$-dimensional sign cube.
